faq.question: Is baby formula allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Baby Formula is restricted in carry-on luggage. Formula is exempt from the 3.4 oz limit. You can bring reasonable quantities in carry-on bags, but they are subject to separate screening.

faq.question: Can you pack baby formula in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Baby Formula is allowed in checked bags.
